mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST increased over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals deflationary pressure, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a quarter signals strong economic growth and a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & UNRATE decreases over 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased over a quarter.
